rows.subtype: Approach: revisiting the rules when circumstances change [Revision]
rows.description: After one partner changes jobs and the income drops, they hold a special meeting, cut two categories and adjust contributions. Rules are treated as a working agreement rather than a fixed law.

rows.description: A wife notices her mother-in-law's insistence on cooking for the family comes from a wish to feel needed. She considers ways to include her rather than only resisting.

rows.subtype: Approach: agreeing with the spouse before speaking to parents [Action]
